intro.text: Commander. We captured this one slaughtering Alliance soldiers on Iokath. She nearly killed me before we subdued her.
I have returned, Jedi. The power stations are down.
Master, I'm plagued.
Master, everything else aside, the visceral experience of facing Lord Cendence continues to tantalize me. I relive it nightly and awaken buzzing.
All alert, the enemy is sighted!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! You got all the soldiers. We ain't fighters, just miners. Contracted miners at that.
[You insert the vault code sequencer.]
Master, your indulgence, please. We haven't spoken for some time. Are you upset with me?
Master, remember the last Imperial port we were docked at? Because I don't. Think I partied a little too hard there.
Sith conquer all our Talz. Fetzellen commands this clan. Fetzellen is the strongest of clan.
Thank you for granting me this audience, master. I'll only take a moment.
Your invasion ends here, Sith. You are severely outnumbered
Master, I have exciting news! A trail of corpses--all slain the same as the light side Sith I found--has led me to the perpetrator.
Master, as time passes, the thrill of killing the light side Sith is ebbing.
Master. I know I've been moody lately. Preoccupied about the false Sith I seek.
Are you Vana-Xo? I require the Blessing of Oneness.
Master, I've become aware of an amazing development.
Have my powers waned as I languished here?
It's so amusing to think I was once training to be a Jedi.
What is on your mind, apprentice?
You have something to tell me?
Zujen was right--your power is even stronger than anticipated.
The Hand is secure, apprentice. Join me aboard my ship at once.
Wrath, finally--I am Servant Twelve. We're safe for the moment, but you must move quickly.
We've cleared the blast, my lord. The fortress of the Hand is no more.
Master, when it is convenient, I'd like to speak with you.
Master, when we return to the ship. I'd appreciate some time to talk.
I have returned, Jedi. The power stations are down.

Whoa, whoa, whoa! You got all the soldiers. We ain't fighters, just miners. Contracted miners at that.

Zujen was right--your power is even stronger than anticipated.

Wrath, finally--I am Servant Twelve. We're safe for the moment, but you must move quickly.
We've cleared the blast, my lord. The fortress of the Hand is no more.
Master, when you have a moment, I'd like to speak with you.
Master, when we return to the ship, I hope we can take a moment and talk.
The shuttle pilot told me Odessen was a formidable base, but it's even more impressive in person. Jedi and Sith working side by side...it's surreal.
Master? You've returned!
You crushed Alderaan under your boot, apprentice. I am incredibly impressed; the planet will feel the sting for years to come.
You have done admirably, apprentice. Your time on Tatooine was well-spent.
My... wound is mortal, Sith. At least I die knowing you'll never find Jaesa....
You've got a serious look in your eye.
Wrath, your first opportunity to tear down what Baras creates is on Belsavis, a planet that was hidden from the Empire until recently.
The Emperor's Voice is secure.
Master, I am aware of no doubt nor insecurity within me. My clarity has never been more pronounced.
Master, I should have requested an audience with you some time ago. I have exciting news!
You have something to tell me?
Master, one of the Sith I tried to connect to has contacted me. It seems he's ready to trust us!
Master, may I break character for a moment? Speak as a Jedi?
Master, I'm plagued.
Master, have you noticed how much more effective in battle I've become?
Wrath, your first opportunity to tear down what Baras creates is on Belsavis, a planet that was hidden from the Empire until recently.
Master, a terrible development.
The Emperor's Voice is secure.
